title: Voice chat can ask the mastermind: two steps in the Claude app

owner_note.text: The connector is live behind a secret address through a free tunnel. Copy the address from %LOCALAPPDATA%\lew42\servex\remote.url into Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector in the Claude app, then try "ask the mastermind what landed today" in a voice chat. Whether voice mode on the phone can call a custom connector is the open question; the doc says what to look for.
